map.→ 打开由扭矩、长度与刚度求扭转角工具: -> Open the Torsion Angle from Torque, Length, and Stiffness tool
map.传动轴在扭矩作用下的单位长度扭转角校核。: Check of the angle of twist per unit length of a drive shaft under torque.
map.剪切模量，钢约 79～80 GPa，与材料有关，越大越抗扭变形。: Shear modulus, about 79 to 80 GPa for steel; it depends on the material, and the larger it is, the more resistant the material is to torsional deformation.
map.对比不同直径轴的抗扭刚度。: Compare the torsional stiffness of shafts with different diameters.
map.扭转角过大会怎样？: What Happens When the Angle of Twist Is Too Large?
map.由扭矩、长度与刚度求扭转角 使用指南: Angle of Twist from Torque, Length, and Stiffness Guide
map.直径加倍刚度提升: Stiffness gain from doubling the diameter
map.输入圆轴所受扭矩 T、轴段长度 L、剪切模量 G 与直径 d，计算极惯性矩 J: Enter the torque T on a solid circular shaft, the segment length L, the shear modulus G, and the diameter d to compute the polar moment of inertia J and the angle of twist θ=T·L/(G·J), used to check the torsional deformation of shaft parts under torque.
map.输入扭矩 T、长度 L、剪切模量 G、直径 d，求扭转角。: Enter the torque T, the length L, the shear modulus G, and the diameter d to find the angle of twist.
map.过大会引起传动相位误差、啮合冲击，精度设备须限制 θ 在允许范围。: Too large a value causes drive phase error and meshing impact, so precision equipment must limit θ to the allowable range.
map.长轴系刚度设计，限制扭转角避免联动误差。: Stiffness design for a long shaft train, limiting the angle of twist to avoid linkage error.
map.：d 由 0.05 增到 0.10：J 增至 16 倍，同扭矩下 θ 缩至约 1: : Raising d from 0.05 to 0.10 multiplies J by 16, and at the same torque θ shrinks to about 1/16 (0.00064 rad).
